parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this IPv4 address.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of this {{object}} table entry. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error_Misconfigured}} value indicates that a necessary configuration value is undefined or invalid. The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: {{datatype|expand}} This parameter can only be modified if {{param|AddressingType}} is {{enum|Static|AddressingType}}.

parameters.name: IPAddress
parameters.description: IPv4 address. This parameter can only be modified if the {{param|AddressingType}} is {{enum|Static|AddressingType}}.

parameters.name: SubnetMask
parameters.description: Subnet mask. This parameter can only be modified if the {{param|AddressingType}} is {{enum|Static|AddressingType}}.

parameters.name: AddressingType
parameters.description: Addressing method used to assign the IP address. {{enum}}

object.description: IPv4 address table. Entries are auto-created and auto-deleted as IP addresses are added and deleted via DHCP, auto-IP, 3GPP-NAS (3GPP Non Access Stratum), or IPCP. Static entries are created and configured by the Controller.
